product_metadata.title: Candeo Candle Coconut Milk Scented - Soy Tealight Candles, 12 Pack - White Tealight Candles - Highly Scented - Made with Soy Wax - Handmade in The USA Summer Scents
features: LONG LASTING: Each tealight candle has a long lasting burn time of 5-6 hours and comes in a bulk resealable bag of 50 tealights to provide you with many hours of amazing clean burning fragrance.
HIGHLY SCENTED: Our soy tealight candles are highly scented and crafted with the finest wax made from soybeans, a renewable crop grown in the USA by American farmers.
BEAUTIFUL CANDLELIGHT: Our tealight candles are a standard size of 1.5" diameter by .75" tall and are poured in clear polycarbonate cup which allows the glow of the flame to shine through!
MADE IN THE USA: Proudly Handmade in the USA! Each tealight is poured, wicked, labeled and packed by hand in small batch
COCONUT MILK: Creamy fresh coconut with just a touch of sweetness.
